_comment: Explicit CI shard assignment for the browser suite (4 parallel runners). Every e2e/*.spec.ts must appear in exactly one group (scripts/e2e-shard.mjs enforces this in CI). E10 generated route coverage replaces the old duplicate axe route loops; focused legacy keyboard/menu/theme regressions remain. Generated scans are split across browser-b/c/d from measured runtimes; no fifth runner. 2026-10-06 (PR #266): the generated route scans and the read-only owner/portal section scans run in Playwright parallel mode (both workers), and groups were rebalanced from measured test-seconds after that change (a 158, b 94, c 105, d 133) to roughly 111-126 each. 2026-10-24 (ACC-3): moved revenue-records and website-editor from browser-b to browser-a because browser-b ran 186s against the 180s budget (a 159, b 341, c 299, d 198 test-seconds). 2026-10-25 (MCP-10a): browser-a ran 179s and browser-d 181s against the 180s budget, so feedback.spec.ts (new, ~18 test-seconds) and crm-workspace.spec.ts (~40-55 test-seconds) moved to browser-c, the lightest group (118s). 2026-10-25 (AR-0a): browser-c ran 3.1m against the 180s budget (a 2.7m, b 1.8m, d 2.6m), so crm-workspace.spec.ts (~45-55 test-seconds) moved to browser-b, the lightest group. 2026-10-25 (MCP-1): measured a 2.7m, b 3.1m (over budget once crm-workspace landed), c 2.5m, d 2.4m; system-health.spec.ts (now ~14 test-seconds) moved to browser-d and fleet-report.spec.ts (~16 test-seconds) from browser-b to browser-c. 2026-10-25 (AR-0b): measured a 128s, b 215s, c 183s, d 128s (budget 180s), so crm-workspace.spec.ts (~50 test-seconds) moved from browser-b to browser-a and the three new AR-0b specs (today, customer-record, money-bills; ~30 test-seconds together) went to browser-d. 2026-10-26 (ZONE-1): measured a 3.2m (over budget with crm-workspace), b 2.0m, c 2.7m, d 1.9m, so crm-workspace.spec.ts (~54 test-seconds) moved from browser-a; browser-d then ran 3.3m with it, so it sits in browser-b (2.0m without it). service-area-map.spec.ts (~4 test-seconds) is in browser-b.
